topics.topic: Define the stable persisted identifier/model fact for a specific FlowActivation so EffectAttempt.authority (and other records) can reference it unambiguously
questions: What concrete, stable reference value identifies a FlowActivation's "position in the store's order" when an EffectAttempt stores authority?
What is the stable, persisted identifier of a specific FlowActivation record that other records reference?
What exact model fact identifies one FlowActivation record so it can be referenced later as authority (and distinguished from another activation of the same version)?

quotes:
The authority is named by its identity: an
  approval or a grant by its minted id, a flow activation by its position in
  the store's order (M18), so a version activated again never makes the
  reference ambiguous;

Substitution: fails — each activation is one issued selection; activating the
same flow version again is a new record with its own position in the store's
order (A01 rule 3), not the earlier one.
judgement.why: State 1 already defines the reference basis for FlowActivation as its unique position in the store order, explicitly to avoid ambiguity across repeated activations of the same flow version.

questions: What is the model fact for `instance_class` (closed enum vs opaque string), and if enum, what are its allowed values?

topics.topic: Decide whether OperationBinding acceptance is unique or can be concurrent for the same (service_id, operation_name, record_digest)
questions: May multiple bindings for the same (service_id, operation_name, record_digest) be accepted at the same time, or must acceptance be unique per operation pin?

topics.topic: Define what time/window criterion makes traces and trial evidence count as “recent” for agent repair context
questions: How is "recent" defined for traces and trial evidence shown to the agent?

topics.topic: Specify rollback behavior when the admitted implementation is not earlier than current (refuse vs create a new Activation)
questions: If the requested implementation is admitted but is not earlier (for example, it is already current), must rollback refuse or create another Activation record anyway?

topics.topic: Specify the State 1 identity-hash field set (“meaning facts”) for content-derived value models without explicit *_id formulas
questions: For value models whose identity is content-derived (especially those without an explicit `*_id` formula, such as FlowNode/FlowEdge/FlowConstant/WaitingPoint), which exact fields are the "meaning facts" included in identity hashing at State 1?
